name: RD Station MCP
description: Connects ChatGPT, Claude and other MCP clients to RD Station Marketing, CRM and Conversas to analyze campaigns, pipelines and support, and act on contacts.

skills.name: Analyze Marketing
skills.description: Investigates campaigns, channels and conversions in RD Station Marketing to find what drives or blocks lead generation.

skills.name: Analyze Sales Pipeline
skills.description: Analyzes the RD Station CRM pipeline and deal history to find loss patterns and stalled negotiations.

skills.name: Analyze Customer Service
skills.description: Relates conversation volume, channels and satisfaction in RD Station Conversas to explain the customer experience.

skills.name: Act on Contacts and Deals
skills.description: Creates contacts, moves deals and triggers automations in RD Station, within the account's permissions and after confirmation.
